method.state: Isolated profiles; no project, conversation or generation. BEX and Claude signed out; Codex auto-restored existing Windows login (verified by login status). Codex is a reference, not an auth-matched comparison.
method.cache: One excluded warm-up per app; five valid launches per app; warm OS caches; rotating order (last BEX/Claude completed after authentication audit)
method.window: perf_counter before Popen to first visible top-level window >=320x200; 20ms sleep between checks; includes process enumeration overhead; not usable-content readiness
method.memory: Process tree including BEX Host and all discovered descendants; psutil memory_full_info; 11 samples at 20..30 seconds; median per run, then median across five valid runs
method.uss: Unique/private resident RAM in MiB (2^20 bytes), excluding shared pages and GPU memory
method.rss: Sum of process resident working sets; shared pages may be counted multiple times
method.private_commit: Private committed virtual memory; may be paged out, not physical RAM
method.shutdown: Only harness-launched processes are terminated after each run; profiles reused
method.interruption: Initial sequence completed four runs per app and the fifth Codex run before authentication audit. Claude and BEX final runs completed afterward with the same profiles. Codex original fifth result was retained, not replaced by the higher-memory duplicate diagnostic. Failed diagnostics and a BEX sample missing its preexisting Host were excluded; BEX final valid run started a new Host.
method.limits: Single PC; unrelated apps and tasks remained running; no reboot/cache flush; not an authenticated coding workload, mobile test, network reliability test, or causal test of Rust versus other languages

rejected_attempts.reason: Window disappeared during measurement; no valid result file. Original planned fifth run remained valid and was retained.
Not part of planned five; original fifth result was retained before duplicate completed
